title: Neural network selects a mitoxantrone and gambogic acid pair for pyroptosis in TNBC
summary: A biofactor-regulated neural network built from a large triple-negative breast cancer cohort and drug databases screened compound pairs for pyroptosis therapy. The preferred pair, mitoxantrone and gambogic acid, was prepared as biomimetic nanococrystals that regulated pyroptosis genes through ribosomal stress in TNBC models.
ai_technology: Biofactor-regulated neural network for drug-pair screening

evidence.tested: Preparation of nanococrystals and mechanistic testing in TNBC models.
evidence.unknown: Preclinical models only; no clinical data; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
